verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server whose tools let AI agents interact with the Stripe API, which Terminal's API-based integration is part of. The pack does not show that the MCP server exposes Terminal-specific operations such as readers, locations or in-person payments, so its coverage for this product is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of Terminal-specific MCP tools, setup/auth documentation for agent connection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base, including documentation and support articles.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
